notes: No model in the repository reads from this source; variables are the full lexicon VOCAB. (earth2studio/lexicon/isd.py ISDLexicon.VOCAB, 8 keys).

Stations are USAF+WBAN IDs (Oakland, San Francisco, Atlanta Hartsfield, Atlanta Fulton Co) taken from ISD.get_stations_bbox; time and 2 h tolerance follow the class docstring example (isd.py:102-103).
Cost scales with the station list, not the variable count: each station-year CSV is downloaded whole.
